summary: Elevate your NGO's mission with our course on Green Fundraising and Eco-Friendly Practices. Gain essential skills to promote sustainability and drive change!
lede: Green fundraising helps NGO teams align fundraising activities with environmental goals and document their choices. For fundraising, communications, events and sustainability staff, the course addresses how to reduce campaign impacts while keeping donor practices transparent. Participants practice mapping campaign footprints, choosing lower-impact suppliers and channels, planning sustainable events, and preparing evidence-based donor reports and simple KPI dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for NGO professionals who manage fundraising, communications, partnerships, events, and sustainability decisions in resource-constrained environments.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of NGO fundraising, donor communication, and basic campaign planning. You should be comfortable reviewing budgets, supplier quotes, event plans, and simple reporting templates. No coding is required. A practical understanding of sustainability concepts, procurement decisions, or environmental reporting is helpful but not mandatory. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational application level, with hands-on exercises using campaign templates, checklists, and reporting tools.
